mapper.select: SELECT t.id,t.name,t.description,t.category,t.requirement_type requirementType, t.assessment_id assessmentId,t.survey_enabled surveyEnabled,ta.assigned_at assignedAt, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM training_survey_response r WHERE r.training_id=t.id AND r.employee_id=#{employeeId}) surveySubmitted, s.id sessionId,s.started_at startedAt,s.completed_at confirmedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_video v WHERE v.training_id=t.id) +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_material m JOIN training_material_page mp ON mp.material_id=m.id WHERE m.training_id=t.id) totalUnits, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidate_video_progress p JOIN training_video v ON v.id=p.video_id WHERE p.session_id=s.id AND v.training_id=t.id AND p.completed=1) +(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidate_material_progress p JOIN training_material m ON m.id=p.material_id WHERE p.session_id=s.id AND m.training_id=t.id AND p.completed=1) completedUnits, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.studied_seconds) FROM candidate_video_progress p JOIN training_video v ON v.id=p.video_id WHERE v.training_id=t.id AND p.session_id=s.id),0) +COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.studied_seconds) FROM candidate_material_progress p JOIN training_material m ON m.id=p.material_id WHERE m.training_id=t.id AND p.session_id=s.id),0) studiedSeconds, (SELECT MAX(p.completed_at) FROM candidate_video_progress p JOIN training_video v ON v.id=p.video_id WHERE v.training_id=t.id AND p.session_id=s.id) videoCompletedAt, (SELECT MAX(p.completed_at) FROM candidate_material_progress p JOIN training_material m ON m.id=p.material_id WHERE m.training_id=t.id AND p.session_id=s.id) readingCompletedAt, a.name examName,a.start_at examStartAt,a.end_at examEndAt,a.status examLifecycle, a.allow_retake allowRetake,a.max_attempts maxAttempts,a.show_result_immediately resultVisible, aa.id attemptId,aa.status attemptStatus,aa.score,aa.total_score totalScore,aa.passed, aa.started_at examStartedAt,aa.submitted_at examSubmittedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assessment_attempt x JOIN assessment_participant p ON p.id=x.participant_id WHERE p.task_id=a.id AND p.employee_id=#{employeeId}) attemptCount FROM training_audience ta JOIN training t ON t.id=ta.training_id LEFT JOIN assessment_task a ON a.id=t.assessment_id LEFT JOIN candidate_learning_session s ON s.id=(SELECT MAX(x.id) FROM candidate_learning_session x WHERE x.employee_id=#{employeeId} AND (x.training_id=t.id OR x.task_id=t.assessment_id)) LEFT JOIN assessment_attempt aa ON aa.id=(SELECT MAX(x.id) FROM assessment_attempt x JOIN assessment_participant p ON p.id=x.participant_id WHERE p.task_id=a.id AND p.employee_id=#{employeeId}) WHERE ta.employee_id=#{employeeId} AND t.created_by=#{enterpriseId} ORDER BY ta.assigned_at DESC,t.id DESC

SELECT v.id,v.title,'VIDEO' materialType,1 totalUnits,COALESCE(p.completed,0) completedUnits,COALESCE(p.studied_seconds,0) studiedSeconds,p.completed_at completedAt FROM training_video v LEFT JOIN candidate_video_progress p ON p.video_id=v.id AND p.session_id=#{videoSessionId} WHERE v.training_id=#{trainingId} UNION ALL SELECT m.id,m.title,m.material_type materialType,m.page_count totalUnits, COALESCE(SUM(p.completed),0) completedUnits,COALESCE(SUM(p.studied_seconds),0) studiedSeconds, CASE WHEN SUM(p.completed)=m.page_count THEN MAX(p.completed_at) END completedAt FROM training_material m LEFT JOIN candidate_material_progress p ON p.material_id=m.id AND p.session_id=#{materialSessionId} WHERE m.training_id=#{materialTrainingId} GROUP BY m.id,m.title,m.material_type,m.page_count

SELECT a.id,a.task_id taskId,t.name,a.status,a.attempt_no attemptNo,a.score,a.total_score totalScore,a.passed, a.started_at startedAt,a.submitted_at submittedAt, CASE WHEN a.submitted_at IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,a.started_at,a.submitted_at)) END durationSeconds, t.show_result_immediately showResultImmediately FROM assessment_attempt a JOIN assessment_task t ON t.id=a.task_id JOIN assessment_participant p ON p.id=a.participant_id WHERE t.created_by=#{enterpriseId} AND p.employee_id=#{employeeId} ORDER BY a.id DESC

SELECT aa.id,q.id questionId,t.name examName,q.stem,aa.answer_text userAnswer,q.answer_text correctAnswer,q.analysis FROM assessment_answer aa JOIN assessment_attempt a ON a.id=aa.attempt_id JOIN assessment_task t ON t.id=a.task_id JOIN assessment_participant p ON p.id=a.participant_id JOIN question_item q ON q.id=aa.question_id WHERE t.created_by=#{enterpriseId} AND p.employee_id=#{employeeId} AND a.status='SUBMITTED' AND t.show_result_immediately=1 AND COALESCE(aa.is_correct,0)=0 AND a.id=(SELECT MAX(a2.id) FROM assessment_attempt a2 WHERE a2.participant_id=p.id AND a2.status='SUBMITTED') ORDER BY aa.id DESC
SELECT question_id questionId,option_key optionKey,option_text optionText FROM question_option WHERE question_id IN (#{id}) ORDER BY sort_no,id
